timeline: You know him as the Iron Man, but Sardar Patel's 1947 integration of 562 princely states changed the map forever.
Did iron grit alone build modern India's borders?
Most assume foreign force shaped the fragmented map.
Others guess swift military conquest solved everything instantly.
Quiet persuasion achieved what armies never could.
He worked tirelessly to bring the fragmented states together under one nation.
Princes surrendered crowns to forge one united nation.
That impossible unity birthed the giant we see today.
Every giant leap starts with a single iron will.
You know him as the Iron Man, but Sardar Patel's 1947 integration of 562 princely states changed the map forever.
